answer: Divergence-Locked Identity Verification This protocol assigns each node an ongoing stream of unique, unpredictable challenges that require genuine path-dependent history to solve, much like calculating the exact orbit of a comet. When an attacker spawns duplicates to manipulate a resource pool, the clones receive identical inputs and produce perfectly synchronized outputs instead of branching naturally like trees in an orchard. The validation layer inspects this behavioral output and drops any identities locked in a rigid spiral of identical state transitions.
